description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 scores achieved by several models across six datasets. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, labeled “Dataset”, with categories including SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four sets of bars are presented for each dataset, representing the models MADLLM, MADLLM without prompt pool, MADLLM without feature embedding, and MADLLM without skip embedding, indicated by the legend. The bars are grouped, with each group corresponding to a specific dataset; within each group, the bars are ordered as MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (red). For the SMD dataset, the F1 scores are approximately 96, 94, 95, and 92 for the four models respectively, while for the WADI dataset, the scores are approximately 73, 71, 75, and 68. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not indicate any specific sorting order beyond the dataset order on the horizontal axis.
